Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Name: Democritus ADV

Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Ventrue
Group: 1
Capacity: 10
Discipline: AUS CEL FOR DOM PRE
Camarilla Ventrue Justicar:
[MERGED] Democritus may search your library for a unique card and put that card in play as a +1 stealth action. Democritus may only do this if that card would contest a card that is already in play.

Messages.Author: LivesByProxy
Messages.Body:
@Kraus, @Ankha: If the effect needs to be more powerful, why not let Democritus' action put the unique card into play? Is putting it into play really more complicated than moving it to your hand?

My suggestion (Ankha + OP's):

Democritus can search your library for a copy of a unique card in play, reveal it, and put it into play as a +1 stealth action (this will cause that card to become contested; you cannot contest cards with yourself).

Although ReverendRevolver is touching on the idea of putting cards into play as a copy of another card, which is a worthwhile design space, should be explored. The idea of a political deck that forces contests to tax its prey's pool is a cool one IMO.

Edit: I also like Lech's suggestion of keeping the Justicar curse, hahaha.

Gangrel. Noddist. Camarilla. Once each turn, LivesByProxy may burn 1 blood to lose Protean  until the end of the turn and gain your choice of superior Auspex , Obfuscate , or Potence  for the current action.

Messages.Author: 1uck
Messages.Body: Limiting it to putting the card into your hand means it would only function with cards that you could normally play. Allowing cards to be put directly into play could lead to some bizarre effects; potentially you could get a free Remnant or Gurchon Hall, or all sorts of cards you couldn't normally play.

Messages.Author: Arthur Volts
Messages.Body:
This is my version I've had kicking around for a long while.

Democritus 1
Clan: Ventrue
Capacity: 10
Camarilla. Justicar.
AUS DOM FOR PRE CEL pot
May place the top card of your ash heap into play face down to contest any non-vampire card or title as a +1 Stealth action that costs 2 blood. Remove both cards from the game if Democritus wins.
ADV: Democritus may pay the cost in blood for any cards you are contesting. +1 Bleed. +1 Hand Damage.

----So yes, he can contest ANY minion card, not just a unique card. He is basically out to cause pain and chaos, because if he wins you don't gain anything, but denying your opponent whatever was contested and their pool lost.----
